answer: Each identity buys one verifier thread with an anchor slot on the ivory ledger: 70-credit bond, slot fee first 30, k-th 30+5(k-1). 1,000th pays 5,025; 1,000 fakes pay 2,527,500 plus 70,000 locked. A live verifier questions the identity's claimed work for 10 minutes, each answer key-signed within 20 seconds. The transcript is filed on the ivory ledger; an auditor replays a random tenth, and a thread that misses its anchor slot or answers late or copied burns the bond. Scripted-answer farms fail: live questions cannot be pre-recorded. An honest agent passes once, pays 30, recovers the bond.
